$comment: This repository's axes for the shared internal-reference gate in @cosyte/script-utils (README, runInternalRefsScan). The prefixes, the standards designations that collide with them, and the surface are the ones the retired scripts/check-no-internal-refs.sh carried. Its roadmap-citation rule, which the canonical set lacks, is added below, and so is its reading of slice after the and each, which the canonical jargon rule narrowed in 0.1.6 and which in this package is only ever our word for a unit of work. The samples are that script's self-tests: the public-surface, doc-comment and runtime-message sentences each rule must catch and the astm reference vocabulary (SPEC-7, ACC-42, E1381 protocol phases, the warning codes) it must let through.
